content:
jorge: quick postmortem follow-up from the churn last night. two ideas: (1) introduce a border-gatekeeper layer that enforces residency+eviction budget before any region-promote, (2) tighten the lease/epoch tie-breaker so proxies can decisively reject split-brain plans.

ama: +1. can you expand on "border-gatekeeper"? sounds like access control for swaps.

jorge: think of it as a lightweight policy enforcer co-located with control-plane. it checks: residency-stamp, eviction-tokens, cooldown level, and prewarm status. only if gatekeeper returns OK does control-plane emit a shift_plan. gatekeeper also returns a reason code for audit.

sylvie: will gatekeeper be synchronous? worried about adding latency to decision path.

jorge: keep it async-fast: cache policies in-memory, decision in <50ms. fallback: if cache-miss, assume conservative (block cross-border) until control-plane validates. we avoid blocking critical emergency_failover by an "force=true" operator flag that still logs and increments audit severity.

ama: we need clear reason codes for metrics: BLOCK_RESIDENCY, BLOCK_BUDGET, BLOCK_PREWARM, ALLOW. also include suggested action (prewarm, wait, operator-ack).

devops-bot: scheduled job: policy-cache-refresh every 30s -> note in audit.

sylvie: about lease/epoch: current tie-break is time-based which caused ambiguity when control-plane partitioned. propose lease tuple = (region-id, epoch-num, signed-lease) where epoch-num is strictly monotonic and signed by control-plane key. proxies accept plans only if incoming epoch > local_epoch OR signed-lease matches operator-ack token.

jorge: signed-lease solves ambiguous wins. also attach last-controlplane-heartbeat timestamp so proxies can detect stale-controller and refuse promotions if heartbeats absent for >T unless emergency flag set.

ama: combine both: gatekeeper enforces policy; lease tuple prevents split-brain. also add a small audit-excerpt in each shift_plan so operators can see gate checks that passed/failed.

sylvie: prewarm side: when gatekeeper blocks for PREWARM, it should return a prioritized prewarm ticket instead of blunt block. tickets contain types (kv, embeddings, model-cache) and priority. prewarm service consumes tickets respecting residency.

privacy: security review: prewarm tickets must never include PII and must honor hard-residency. also tickets should carry consent-stamp hash and be encrypted between control-plane and prewarm workers.

jorge: config sketch (conceptual):

```
border_gatekeeper:
  cache_ttl_sec: 30
  emergency_override_ttl_sec: 300
  cooldown_base_sec: 60
  eviction_tokens_default: 3
  prewarm_ticket_ttl_sec: 900
  audit_reasons: ["BLOCK_RESIDENCY","BLOCK_BUDGET","BLOCK_PREWARM","ALLOW"]
lease_policy:
  min_heartbeat_sec: 10
  stale_guard_sec: 45
  require_signed_lease: true
```

ama: operator UX: need a single "gate view" showing per-tenant gate status, last gate decision, token counts, and option to grant one-time operator ack. add a bulk-ack tool for migrations.

sylvie: failure modes: (A) gatekeeper cache staleness -> false block; mitigations: conservative-fallback + alert on cache-miss rate. (B) prewarm backlog -> delaying swaps; mitigations: prioritized prewarm and fallbacks to reduced traffic shift. (C) signed-lease key rollover -> proxies reject valid new leases; mitigation: dual-signing window and rolling key push. document all in runbook.

devops-bot: feature-flag: border-gatekeeper-v1 -> canary on 2026-02-18T00:30Z.

jorge: testing: unit tests for gate logic, integration test with proxy epoch checks, chaos tests: control-plane partition + rapid p95 blips, and scale prewarm load test. need SLOs for gate decision latency (<50ms 99th).

ama: metrics/event list: gate_decision{tenant,reason}, prewarm_ticket{tenant,type,priority}, lease_reject{tenant,local_epoch,incoming_epoch}, swap_attempt{tenant,from,to,decision}. dashboard + alerts for swap_attempt rate and lease_reject spikes.

privacy: also verify logs do not leak tenant identifiers outside operator ACLs. sign consent-stamp with control-plane KMS and surface only hash in events.

jorge: will draft RFC section: gatekeeper API, lease tuple spec, prewarm-ticket schema, and operator UI mocks. aim to open PR by EOD tomorrow. anyone take ownership of proxy patch for epoch validation?

sylvie: I'll own proxy patch and add epoch enforcement + signed-lease verification.

ama: I'll own gatekeeper prototype and gate UI mockups. privacy please review prewarm ticket flow before canary.

privacy: will schedule review and provide required header/secret patterns.

jorge: thanks all. if no objections I'll open RFC PR tomorrow and attach canary checklist. :thumbsup:
